# divseg

`divseg` implements common measures of diversity (within-geography) and
segregation (across-geographies).

## Installation

You can install the released version of divseg from
[CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org) with:

``` r

install.packages("divseg")
```

You can install the released version of divseg from
[GitHub](https://github.com/christopherkenny/divseg/) with:

``` r

pak::pak('christopherkenny/divseg')
```

## Example

The basic workflow relies on a `tibble` where each row represents a
geography and has columns that represent some form of population data.

``` r

library(divseg)
#> 
#> Attaching package: 'divseg'
#> The following object is masked from 'package:base':
#> 
#>     interaction
```

`divseg` comes with two example datasets. `de_county` contains 2010
Census data on the counties in Delaware. `de_tract` likewise has 2010
Census data on the tracts in Delaware.

``` r

data('de_county')
data('de_tract')
```

A pretty standard function call returns a vector, where the first entry
is a `tibble` and the second is `tidyselect` language.

``` r

ds_blau(.data = de_county, .cols = starts_with('pop_'))
#> [1] 0.5155228 0.5570435 0.4052769
```

More importantly, if you specify an argument to `.name`, all functions
are pipe-able.

``` r

de_county |>
  ds_blau(starts_with('pop_'), .name = 'blau') |>
  ds_delta(starts_with('pop_'), .name = 'delta') |>
  dplyr::relocate(blau, delta)
#> Simple feature collection with 3 features and 22 fields
#> Geometry type: MULTIPOLYGON
#> Dimension:     XY
#> Bounding box:  xmin: -75.78866 ymin: 38.45101 xmax: -75.04894 ymax: 39.83901
#> Geodetic CRS:  NAD83
#> # A tibble: 3 × 23
#>    blau delta GEOID NAME     pop pop_white pop_black pop_hisp pop_aian pop_asian
#>   <dbl> <dbl> <chr> <chr>  <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>    <dbl>    <dbl>     <dbl>
#> 1 0.516 0.345 10001 Kent… 162310    105891     37812     9346      916      3266
#> 2 0.557 0.345 10003 New … 538479    331836    124426    46921      984     23132
#> 3 0.405 0.345 10005 Suss… 197145    149025     24544    16954      924      1910
#> # ℹ 13 more variables: pop_nhpi <dbl>, pop_other <dbl>, pop_two <dbl>,
#> #   vap <dbl>, vap_white <dbl>, vap_black <dbl>, vap_hisp <dbl>,
#> #   vap_aian <dbl>, vap_asian <dbl>, vap_nhpi <dbl>, vap_other <dbl>,
#> #   vap_two <dbl>, geometry <MULTIPOLYGON [°]>
```

Each function has a partner that can go inside calls to
[`dplyr::mutate()`](https://dplyr.tidyverse.org/reference/mutate.html)
by dropping the `ds_` prefix:

``` r

de_county |>
  dplyr::mutate(herf = hhi(starts_with('pop_'))) |>
  dplyr::relocate(herf)
#> Simple feature collection with 3 features and 21 fields
#> Geometry type: MULTIPOLYGON
#> Dimension:     XY
#> Bounding box:  xmin: -75.78866 ymin: 38.45101 xmax: -75.04894 ymax: 39.83901
#> Geodetic CRS:  NAD83
#> # A tibble: 3 × 22
#>    herf GEOID NAME           pop pop_white pop_black pop_hisp pop_aian pop_asian
#>   <dbl> <chr> <chr>        <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>    <dbl>    <dbl>     <dbl>
#> 1 0.484 10001 Kent Count… 162310    105891     37812     9346      916      3266
#> 2 0.443 10003 New Castle… 538479    331836    124426    46921      984     23132
#> 3 0.595 10005 Sussex Cou… 197145    149025     24544    16954      924      1910
#> # ℹ 13 more variables: pop_nhpi <dbl>, pop_other <dbl>, pop_two <dbl>,
#> #   vap <dbl>, vap_white <dbl>, vap_black <dbl>, vap_hisp <dbl>,
#> #   vap_aian <dbl>, vap_asian <dbl>, vap_nhpi <dbl>, vap_other <dbl>,
#> #   vap_two <dbl>, geometry <MULTIPOLYGON [°]>
```

# Package index

## Estimating Diversity Indices

Functions for estimating aspatial diversity indices

- [`ds_blau()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_blau.md)
  [`blau()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_blau.md)
  : Compute Blau's Index
- [`ds_diversity()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_diversity.md)
  [`diversity()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_diversity.md)
  [`ds_perplexity()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_diversity.md)
  [`perplexity()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_diversity.md)
  : Compute Diversity
- [`ds_hhi()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_hhi.md)
  [`hhi()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_hhi.md)
  [`ds_simpson()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_hhi.md)
  [`simpson()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_hhi.md)
  : Compute Herfindahl-Hirshman Index
- [`ds_inv_simpson()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_inv_simpson.md)
  [`inv_simpson()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_inv_simpson.md)
  : Compute Simpson Index
- [`ds_reyni()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_reyni.md)
  [`reyni()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_reyni.md)
  : Compute Reyni Entropy
- [`ds_shannon()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_shannon.md)
  [`shannon()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_shannon.md)
  : Compute Shannon Index

## Evenness Segregation Indices

Functions for estimating segregation indices of evenness

- [`ds_atkinson()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_atkinson.md)
  [`atkinson()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_atkinson.md)
  : Compute Atkinson b Index
- [`ds_dissim()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_dissim.md)
  [`dissim()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_dissim.md)
  : Compute Dissimilarity Index
- [`ds_entropy()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_entropy.md)
  [`entropy()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_entropy.md)
  : Compute Entropy Index
- [`ds_gini()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_gini.md)
  [`gini()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_gini.md)
  : Compute Gini Index

## Exposure Segregation Indices

Functions for estimating segregation indices of exposure

- [`ds_correlation()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_correlation.md)
  [`correlation()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_correlation.md)
  : Compute Correlation Index
- [`ds_interaction()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_interaction.md)
  [`interaction()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_interaction.md)
  : Compute Interaction Index
- [`ds_isolation()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_isolation.md)
  [`isolation()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_isolation.md)
  : Compute Isolation Index

## Concentration Segregation Indices

Functions for estimating segregation indices of concentration

- [`ds_abs_conc()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_abs_conc.md)
  [`abs_conc()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_abs_conc.md)
  : Compute Absolute Concentration
- [`ds_delta()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_delta.md)
  [`delta()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_delta.md)
  : Compute Delta Index
- [`ds_rel_conc()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_rel_conc.md)
  [`rel_conc()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_rel_conc.md)
  : Compute Relative Concentration

## Centralization Segregation Indices

Functions for estimating segregation indices of centralization

- [`ds_abs_cent()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_abs_cent.md)
  [`abs_cent()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_abs_cent.md)
  : Compute Absolute Centralization
- [`ds_rel_cent()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_rel_cent.md)
  [`rel_cent()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_rel_cent.md)
  : Compute Relative Centralization

## Clustering Segregation Indices

Functions for estimating segregation indices of clustering

- [`ds_abs_clust()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_abs_clust.md)
  [`abs_clust()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_abs_clust.md)
  : Compute Absolute Clustering
- [`ds_dd_interaction()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_dd_interaction.md)
  [`dd_interaction()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_dd_interaction.md)
  : Compute Distance Decay Interaction
- [`ds_dd_isolation()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_dd_isolation.md)
  [`dd_isolation()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_dd_isolation.md)
  : Compute Distance Decay Isolation
- [`ds_rel_clust()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_rel_clust.md)
  [`rel_clust()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_rel_clust.md)
  : Compute Relative Clustering
- [`ds_spat_prox()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_spat_prox.md)
  [`spat_prox()`](https://christopherkenny.github.io/divseg/reference/ds_spat_prox.md)
  : Compute Spatial Proximity
